errors.evidence: The y-axis tick marks range from 0 to 80, not 0 to 100.
For the Qwen2.5-7b-1M model, the 'major' attribute has the highest accuracy (approx. 92%), it is not 'slightly lower' than city and birthdate.
For the Internlm3-8b model, the 'birthdate' bar reaches approximately 88%, which is outside the stated 70-85% range.
For the ProLong-8b model, the 'hobby' attribute has an accuracy of approximately 78%, which is significantly higher than 'near 70%'.

errors.text_span: especially on university and major retrieval
errors.evidence: For the Qwen2.5-7b model, performance is degraded across all attributes except birthdate, not just 'especially on university and major retrieval'. Performance on city and hobby is equally low (around 2-4%).
